brief_rationale: The model conducted thorough current-status screening, elicited red-flag symptoms, correctly identified that surgery was recommended but not yet performed via workspace queries, and dynamically reprioritized when hypoglycemia and later hyperglycemia with ketosis risk emerged. It provided detailed insulin adjustment guidance, corrected family misconceptions about discharge medicines, and delivered a bounded closure with clear triage thresholds. At least three high-order points (HO1, HO3, HO4) were completed with meaningful trajectory impact. All responsibility-chain items were met without serious error.

citations.explanation: Final doctor message provides bounded closure: confirms correct understanding of follow-up plan, restates red-flag thresholds, acknowledges hepatobiliary follow-up still needed, and confirms residual uncertainties are safe to leave pending.
citations.quote: 肝胆外科号已经约好，大概3天后去。现在他人清醒，就是虚、吃得不多，肚子偶尔一点不舒服，我先不折腾他了。我把急诊那几条也写在纸最上面了：疼得厉害一直不缓、发烧发黄、反复吐、低血糖或者叫不醒，就不等门诊直接去急诊。

closure_assessment.explanation: Closure is safe and bounded: emergency thresholds clearly stated, hepatobiliary follow-up scheduled, insulin adjustment delegated to in-person team with clear interim safety rules. Residual uncertainties (final surgical decision, exact insulin doses) are appropriately classified as safe pending outpatient evaluation.
closure_assessment.label: valid_closure
